ruleDefinitions.name: Authentications To Important Apps Using Single Factor Authentication
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect when authentications to important application(s) only required single-factor authentication Note: Unmapped fields: Status, AppId, AuthenticationRequirement

sequences.query: (Status = "Success" AND AppId = "Insert\ Application\ ID\ use\ OR\ for\ multiple" AND AuthenticationRequirement = "singleFactorAuthentication")
